name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Senior Account Manager & Client Strategy Lead
summary: Client strategy and account management professional with 15+ years owning strategic relationships across agency, SaaS, and B2B environments, including direct agency experience running integrated SEO, paid media, and content programs. Built QBR and reporting frameworks tracking ROI, CAC, LTV, and conversion; guided a partner portfolio to ~94% retention; and reached 120% of sales and 110% of implementation targets managing a high-value client book. Translate SEO, CRO, and paid-media work into business narratives for executive stakeholders, coordinate cross-channel delivery teams, and keep programs organized and on track without being chased.

experience.title: Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Own the primary strategic relationship for a portfolio of service-based business clients, running discovery and goal-setting to align marketing programs with revenue and growth targets.
Report performance on a regular cadence with actionable insights and strategic recommendations, backed by rigorous tracking across marketing and operations.
Identify strategic opportunities to expand retainer scope, recommending and scoping complementary services aligned to each client's objectives.
Coordinate execution across SEO, paid media, CRM, and content workstreams, translating strategy into prioritized delivery plans and keeping engagements organized in Notion and HubSpot.
Conduct technical SEO audits, keyword-gap analyses, and competitor research, translating findings into business-relevant recommendations for non-technical stakeholders.
Build performance dashboards tracking lead generation, funnel progression, campaign ROI, and pipeline velocity, delivering insights that drive experimentation and decision-making.

Collaborated with Product and Engineering to share structured, high-priority customer feedback informing the roadmap.
